d:
Ameriki tek kanpni NVIDIA ke sieeo jensan huaang ke ek chini karobari mahila elis huaang se kathit qaribi sanbandhon ki janch ho rahi hai.
Ameriki khufiya adhikariyon ko shak tha ki elis chin ke lie jasusi kar rahi thin.
Is mamle ne amerika men rashtriy suraksha aur AI ki daur ko lekar naee chintaen paida kar di hain. janie, kaun hain elis huaang aur is pure mamle men ab tak kya samne aaya hai.
Riport: lili jamali aur pitar hoskins
